change.after: "update/delete policies apply only to the application itself"

original.statement: Starting in Argo CD 3.0, application `update` and `delete` RBAC policies no longer apply to sub-resources; the v2 behavior can be kept by setting server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm.

decision.reason: [ev-d0cda25040fe] says the default behaviour changed: update/delete policies used to apply to an Application's sub-resources and now apply only to the application itself. It also names the controlling setting exactly as `server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance`, in the ConfigMap `argocd-cm`. When this key is left unset, the same configuration now behaves differently, so the subject and the behavior-changed type fit. The before/after values say the same thing as the evidence, in slightly shorter wording.
